edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during construction, establishing the privilege principal.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spender authorisation.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-supplied contract after mutating allowance state.
onlyOwner gate controls the arbitrary external ERC20 call target and amount.
Constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the privileged newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Nash constructor mints the initial supply to the owner address.
Fixed supply computed with multiplication and exponent arithmetic in the constructor.
Constructor initialises balances[owner] with the whole supply.
